name: M6.Physical.conv_assoc
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b c : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Physical.conv N a (M6.Physical.conv N b c) = M6.Physical.conv N (M6.Physical.conv N a b) c
guidance: Expand double sums, exchange finite sums and reindex by translations of ZMod N. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
